sources.name: arXiv Papers
sources.description: ML and CS paper abstracts matching your search queries
sources.author: Hollyburn Analytics Inc.

historyReach.note: arXiv answers any date range. A run fetches up to 500 papers per query and the next run carries on, so a deep backfill arrives over several syncs rather than all at once.

sources.egressNote: The adapter queries the arXiv API on export.arxiv.org. arxiv.org appears only as the paper's HTML/PDF `file_url`, which Trove's ingest fetches when it captures the artifact.

sources.name: Podcasts
sources.description: Subscribe to any podcast by feed URL. Trove downloads each new episode and transcribes it, so the whole show becomes searchable text.
sources.author: Hollyburn Analytics Inc.

historyReach.note: Most podcast feeds carry the full back catalogue, but some publishers truncate theirs to recent episodes. How far back you get is the publisher's choice.

sources.egressNote: Fetches the podcast feed URLs the user configures, so the reachable hosts are theirs and cannot be listed here; the audio enclosures those feeds point at are downloaded by Trove's transcription workflow, not by this adapter.

directory.placeholder: Paste a site or feed URL

sources.egressNote: Fetches the feed or site URLs the user configures, so the reachable hosts are theirs and cannot be listed here; a pasted site URL is followed once more to the feed that page advertises.

sources.name: SEC Filings
sources.description: 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, S-1, and F-1 filings for tracked companies via SEC EDGAR
sources.author: Hollyburn Analytics Inc.

tickers.label: Company Tickers
tickers.hint: a ticker symbol such as SHOP or BRK-B, not a company name — search by name in the picker and it fills the symbol in

historyReach.note: EDGAR's submissions endpoint returns only a company's recent filings — roughly the last thousand. Older filings live in separate archives this source does not read.

sources.egressNote: The ticker→CIK map and each filing's EDGAR archive document are on www.sec.gov; the company submissions index is on data.sec.gov.
